'''Wardens''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2 if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4, with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].

==''Behavior'' ==
Wardens are highly mobile, melee units with AoE attacks.

*Their Attack inflicts AoE Damage and is performed by them pushing their limbs upward.
*Wardens can climb Blocks.
*Wardens can perform great leaps. inflicting AoE Damage when it lands.
*They are able to perform a charge attack. After staying still covering their face for some seconds, they'll dash forward at high speed for a short distance. This attack ignores immunity frames and inflicts great knockback, some vertical knockback, and AoE Damage.
**This is indicated by flame particles and a higher pitched growl, as well as the arms covering the face.
*They are able to generate Shockwaves, large damaging areas of disturbed ground. After standing still for a brief period they will summon a wave which moves forward at slow speed attempting to break any blocks they contact. Shockwaves ignore immunity frames and deal massive vertical knockback. 
**This is indicated by flame particles and a higher pitched growl.
*Wardens will regularly preform evasive dashes.
*Wardens can perform small leaps in liquids.
*Wardens can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Wardens can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them.
*Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Wardens can summon [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport them.
**Wardens (along with the other Melee focused Pures) spawn [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]] significantly less than flying and grounded range Pures.
*Wardens can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 2 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherWarden.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Wardens, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* The two humps on Wardens' head function as Weak Points. When one of these Weak Points are hit, damage inflicted to it is tripled and the [[Bleeding]] Effect is applied to it.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Wardens have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

==''Trivia''==
*Wardens are also known as '''Ganro''' in the Mod Files.
*Wardens are inspired by the [https://strangerthings.fandom.com/wiki/The_Demogorgon Demogorgon] from Stranger Things.
*The Warden has gone through 2 Remodels during the [[Version 1.9.0A1|1.9.0A1]] to [[Version 1.9.0A2|1.9.0A2]] Updates, using the [[Marauder]]]] Model in 1.9.0A1 and in the next Update, because of many complaints regarding this change, its pre-1.9.0A1 Model was re-introduced.
*The Warden shares its name with a vanilla mob from a much later version of Minecraft. They have no other relationship beyond the name and both being hostile.
